_source.how:
systemctl / service as uid 1000 (user rec) in containers that boot systemd as PID 1 (docker run --privileged, linux/arm64 Docker Desktop VM, --cgroupns=private); helper images with systemd as PID 1 built from the official image; no tty, stdout / stderr / exit status apart. *_nopolkit: the official image as it is; *_polkit: polkit in the helper image before the boot for deb (w2sd-<key>-pk from scripts/images/polkit/Dockerfile.deb; a polkit installed into a running deb container is not reached through the bus, record_polkit.py:33), installed into the running container for rpm (centos_7, rockylinux_9: its scriptlets reload the bus); *_polkit_tty: as *_polkit with docker exec -t (stdin closed), stdout and stderr merged by the pty, so the stderr text is in the first field and the second is empty; line ends 
 and 
 of the pty normalised to 
 (wave w2/systemd: noroot.json, noroot_polkit.json). Raw: out/raw of that wave.
_source.normalised: hostname -> HOST; PIDs -> PID; nothing in these cases needed more
_source.not_recorded: tty variant of the no-polkit cases (the polkit recording has it: error lines wrapped in ESC[0;1;31m ... ESC[0m on 252, 255 and 257, none on 219 and 249; report.md of the wave says 249 too, its data does not); 232 (EdgeOS) as 219; 250 and 251 as 249; halt as reboot; reset-failed; unmask; enable / disable of a unit without an init script on Debian and Ubuntu; the standalone reboot, poweroff, halt and shutdown programs
